import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_5/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_5/test_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_5/test_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_5/test_3.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_5/test_4.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_5/test_5.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_5/test_6.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_5/test_7.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_5/test_8.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_5/test_9.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_5/test_10.csv"
    ]

    # Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
    dfs = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
        # Ensure columns are exactly ['code', 'name'] and types are correct
        df = df[['code', 'name']].copy()
        # Convert 'code' to integer type explicitly
        df['code'] = df['code'].astype(int)
        # Convert 'name' to string type explicitly
        df['name'] = df['name'].astype(str)
        dfs.append(df)

    # Since all source tables have the same schema ['code', 'name'] which matches the target schema,
    # we can concatenate (union) all source tables directly.
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # The target examples show duplicates exist (e.g., code=11 repeated multiple times),
    # so we do NOT drop duplicates.

    # Final DataFrame is combined_df with columns ['code', 'name'] and correct types.

    # Write the combined DataFrame to the target CSV file
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_5/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    combined_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
